newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Rolls-Royce raised at Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rolls-Royce raised at Lehman.

text.p: British aero-engine maker Rolls-Royce Plc was raised to "neutral" from "underperform" at Lehman Brothers, the investment bank said on Tuesday.
Analyst Guy Kekwick at Lehman said the stock had underperformed the rest of the UK market by 16 percent in the last three months and was now back in the middle of its price range.

Some good newsflow is expected in coming months, Kekwick said, with full-year 1996 results on March 6 expected to show a better result from the aerospace division, supporting a more moderate stance on the stock for the time being.
The shares were up 1/2p at 220-1/2 by 0908 GMT.
